output.reason: The changelog line [ev-dcba186fd8d7] and the PR description [ev-031eb1d260ab] only say that plugin API calls are now retried 'to be more reliable'. They don't say which API is meant (for example, the plugin catalog or download service), what triggers a retry, how many times or with what backoff, or whether any configuration key turns it on. The changed-files list [ev-0eee94577161] shows edits to pkg/plugins/client.go and a new hclog logging adapter, but not the code, so the evidence names no condition for which environments are exposed. Writing the applicability and consequence aspects would need the client.go diff or documentation stating which plugin configuration triggers these calls and what operators see.
